post.title: Driveway Replacement Bothell WA — Right-of-Way Permits, Curb Cuts, Drainage and Concrete Done Right
post.description: A Bothell guide to replacing a concrete driveway: the City right-of-way permit for the apron and curb cut, hard-surface and stormwater rules, utility locates, base, joints and curing in wet weather, permeable options and how to hire.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-17 packets (per parent); PC not touched. Topic: concrete driveway replacement in Bothell WA (first driveway daily).
